question: India is celebrating its _______ Independence Day on August 15, 2025, with PM Narendra Modi leading the celebrations from the iconic Red Fort in Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**79th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India is celebrating its 79th Independence Day on August 15, 2025, with PM Narendra Modi leading the celebrations from the iconic Red Fort in Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 79th Independence Day of India is celebrated on August 15, 2025, with PM Narendra Modi addressing the nation from the Red Fort in Delhi.**
 
• The theme for the celebrations is “Naya Bharat.”
 
• The Indian Air Force coordinated the celebrations, and the Guard of Honour was commanded by Wing Commander AS Sekhon.
 
• Flying Officer Rashika Sharma assisted in hoisting the National Flag, marking a significant moment in the celebrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Operation Sindoor__

 
 
• Operation Sindoor is a symbolic initiative celebrated during the Independence Day of 2025, with various decorations and symbols around it.
 
• Floral decorations and invitation cards bore the logo of Operation Sindoor, showcasing the rise of “Naya Bharat.”
